description: Median household income, per capita income, housing units, owner vs renter occupancy, median home value, median gross and contract rent for a US geography. Used for real estate AI, market analysis, location-based pricing.

county.description: 3-digit county FIPS. Use '*' for all counties in a state. Required for county/tract levels.

msa.description: 5-digit Metropolitan Statistical Area code. Required for msa level.

place.description: Census place FIPS (city). Required for place level.

state.description: 2-letter state code (e.g. 'TX') or 2-digit FIPS. Required for state/county/place/tract levels.

tract.description: 6-digit census tract code. Use '*' for all tracts in a county.

zcta.description: 5-digit ZIP Code Tabulation Area. Required for zcta level.

name: census_income_housing
